BOOK YOUR STAY IN THE PARK LODGING IN YELLOWSTONE NATIONAL PARKYellowstone National Park was established as the world’s first national park on March 1, 1872 and encompasses 2.2 million acres. The park was established for many reasons including the abundance of wildlife and more geysers, hot springs, and geothermal features than anywhere else in the world. Just as the landscape and wildlife are part of the heritage of Yellowstone National Park, so are the lodges, campgrounds, tours, and services operated by Yellowstone National Park Lodges. In the summer, Yellowstone National Park Lodges operates 9 lodges, 4 campgrounds, and 1 RV park. We also offer summer packages and guided land, water, and horseback tours. In the winter, 2 lodges are open, and we offer winter transportation, packages, and tours. We are ready to welcome you and help create meaningful experiences and once-in-a-lifetime adventures. EXPLORE OUR SPECIAL OFFERS LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR LODGES Packages Make the most of your national park adventure with our seasonal vacation packages. Each package is designed to simplify your Yellowstone experience, offering lodging, in-park transportation, expert guides, and more. Enjoy a stress-free getaway and immerse yourself in the beauty of the park. Explore Packages Wondering What to Do? Discover our thoughtfully curated selection of unique Yellowstone-themed merchandise, perfect for park enthusiasts and nature lovers alike. From cozy home furnishings to apparel and gourmet treats like wild huckleberry jam, we offer something special for everyone. At Yellowstone National Park Lodges, you’re invited to discover or rediscover the magic of the world’s first national park, Yellowstone. As proud stewards of the park and this truly extraordinary American wonder, we’ll help you find your ultimate Yellowstone experience—all while working to protect and preserve the park for future generations. Yellowstone continues to provide inspiration for the people of the world and is a reflection of American values and ideals. From lodging, camping and dining to finding your way, things to do or applying for a job, find the information you need for planning a uniquely memorable visit to the extraordinary destination of Yellowstone National Park. Lodges and Campgrounds in Yellowstone National Park Bridge Bay Campground Bridge Bay Campground, near Bridge Bay Marina on Yellowstone Lake, is a scenic campground for RVers and tent campers with a mix of campsites in open grassy meadows and wooded areas. Operating Dates: May 15, 2026 - September 14, 2026 Read More Canyon Campground Located in the heart of Yellowstone, Canyon Campground offers an ideal base for exploring the park's wonders. This wooded campground enjoys easy access to breathtaking canyon views, waterfalls, and nearby amenities in Canyon Village. Operating Dates: May 29, 2026 - September 20, 2026 Read More Canyon Lodge & Cabins Canyon Lodge & Cabins is centrally located in the park, with easy access to both the upper and lower loops of the park, and is just minutes from the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone. Canyon Lodge underwent one of the largest sustainable lodging redevelopment projects in the National Parks, and five lodges, completed in 2016, are LEED certified. Operating Dates: May 15, 2026 - October 25, 2026 Read More Fishing Bridge RV Park Fishing Bridge RV Park is conveniently located on the east side of the park, where Yellowstone Lake exits into the Yellowstone River. This RV Park is only for hard-sided RV travelers, and can accommodate RVs up to 95 feet in length. This is the only campground in the park with full hookups. Operating Dates: May 8, 2026 - October 18, 2026 Read More Grant Village Grant Village is located near the West Thumb Geyser Basin area and is the closest Yellowstone lodging location to Grand Teton National Park. Grant Village offers modern motel-type accommodations tucked away in a forested area along the shore of Yellowstone Lake. Operating Dates: May 29, 2026 - October 11, 2026 Read More Grant Village Campground Located on the southwest shore of Yellowstone Lake, Grant Village Campground offers campsites surrounded by stunning lodgepole pines. Enjoy easy access to the West Thumb Geyser Basin, Old Faithful Village and the south entrance to the park. Operating Dates: June 26, 2026 - September 27, 2026 Read More Lake Lodge Cabins Lake Lodge Cabins are located in the Lake Village on the shores of Yellowstone Lake and offer comfortable cabins with private bathrooms. Enjoy spectacular views of Yellowstone Lake from the porch of the main lodge, and rock your cares away. Operating Dates: June 10, 2026 - October 4, 2026 Read More Lake Yellowstone Hotel & Cabins Step into the charm of Lake Yellowstone Hotel & Cabins, nestled along the beautiful shore of Yellowstone Lake. The oldest hotel in Yellowstone welcomes you with timeless elegance, stunning lake views from the sunroom, and proximity to iconic park attractions. Operating Dates: May 15, 2026 - October 11, 2026 Read More Madison Campground Set near the scenic Madison River, this campground offers sites for tents, RVs, and groups. Enjoy a partly wooded setting with easy access to geyser basins and several rivers for fishing. Operating Dates: May 1, 2026 - October 18, 2026 Read More Mammoth Hot Springs Hotel & Cabins Mammoth Hot Springs Hotel & Cabins is located near the north entrance to the park and is a popular base for wildlife watchers heading to Lamar Valley. The Mammoth Hot Springs Hotel is open in spring, summer, fall, and winter; the longest of any hotel in Yellowstone. Operating Dates: April 24, 2026 - March 8, 2027 Read More Old Faithful Inn Old Faithful Inn is a national historic landmark renowned for its rustic architecture (or parkitecture), featuring towering log construction and a stunning stone fireplace. Built in 1903-1904, this iconic inn places you steps away from the awe-inspiring Old Faithful geyser. Its unique charm and unparalleled location offer an unforgettable Yellowstone experience. Operating Dates: May 1, 2026 - October 12, 2026 Read More Old Faithful Lodge Cabins This historic lodge and cabin facility is located near Old Faithful Geyser Basin. It has a one-story main lodge, built in the 1920s, with massive logs and stone pillars featuring tremendous views of Old Faithful Geyser. Operating Dates: May 8, 2026 - October 4, 2026 Read More Old Faithful Snow Lodge & Cabins Old Faithful Snow Lodge & Cabins is located a short walk from the Old Faithful Geyser Basin and is open in both the summer and winter seasons. The Snow Lodge, the most recent hotel built in Yellowstone, was designed in the classic "parkitecture" style, creating a warm lodge style atmosphere. Operating Dates: April 24, 2026 – October 25, 2026 December 16, 2026 - March 7, 2027 Read More Roosevelt Lodge Cabins Named for Yellowstone enthusiast, conservationist, and president, Theodore Roosevelt, this rustic log lodge and cabin facility was built in 1920. Roosevelt Lodge Cabins are located in the northeast part of the park, making it the perfect place to escape and enjoy easy access to wildlife watching in Lamar Valley.
